target_customer: Utilities, power producers, energy storage and EV charging operators that need electricity price and demand forecasts
problem: Operators of batteries and flexible assets earn more when they can predict electricity prices. inBalance sold machine learning forecasts under the product name Delphi.

founders.name: Thomas Marge
founders.background_notes: Began in energy data with a wind farm optimization project in Lexington, Massachusetts per TechCrunch. Later led battery storage optimization and forecasting at Stem.

founders.name: Rajan Troll
founders.background_notes: Named by TechCrunch, background not found.

founders.name: Edwin Fennell
founders.background_notes: Named by TechCrunch, background not found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Accurate electricity price forecasting across markets with ML is a hard, data heavy problem, and a small remote team served a top 10 US utility and a global asset manager.

defensibility.rationale: Model accuracy and data pipelines could compound, but forecasting vendors such as Montel and in-house teams at storage optimizers could replicate results.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Stem, a storage optimization company where the founder had worked, acquired inBalance in January 2023.

market_need_then: In March 2021 the company had about six early users including a top 10 US utility and a global renewable asset manager, and about 3,000 market participants using its forecasting tools, as TechCrunch reported.

branding.domain_note: Used inbalanceresearch.com, a suffixed domain. The site returned HTTP 404 later.

identity.voice_and_tone: Research style, forecasts framed around revenue improvement

brand_strength.rationale: A generic name shared with several unrelated companies, and searches mostly returned other inBalance or Balance entities. No brand press beyond coverage of the business.

outcome_analysis: inBalance sold ML electricity price forecasts to utilities and storage operators, with Enel named as a live customer, and exited to Stem in January 2023 with the founder joining the acquirer's storage optimization world. No public funding history or price was found, which suggests a capital efficient small team acquired by a strategic buyer in the broader storage software consolidation, though terms are not public.
notes: Acquisition by Stem in January 2023 comes from the founder's bio on the YC page and a Slush profile, a founder statement. A search of Stem news found no corroborating press release, so the date is single sourced. Funding searches returned conflicting aggregator data (2 million dollars 2021-03, 1.8 million dollars 2021-10, 1.61 million dollars total, a Wefunder campaign) that may refer to other companies named inBalance or Balance, so none are recorded. TechCrunch gave no funding amount or competitors. Montel and Enertel were named by search results dated later than the batch, so the competitor list is empty. Location sources conflict (San Francisco, Cambridge, Boston).
